description:
Rockstar is recruiting for a health insurance technology startup that is modernizing and automating the benefits experience. The client is a team of builders backed by investors such as Base10 Partners, Terrain, Conversion Capital, and SemperVirens, firms that have led investments and helped grow companies like Ramp, Rippling, and Blend from the seed stage. The company is headquartered in NYC with a remote-friendly team of about 15 and is seeking early Product Engineers to own problems end to end.
 
 About the Company
 The problem the company is solving: 
 
 Employers collectively spend over a trillion dollars on benefits every year, yet more than 85% of employees find their benefits confusing. This confusion stems from outdated systems and manual processes that lead to errors, delays, and widespread frustration.
 
 The company’s vision is to create an ecosystem where everyone benefits:
 Brokers eliminate busy work and enhance their advisory roles
 Employers receive a tailored, efficient benefits experience with better coverage and service, often at lower costs
 Employees gain clear, accessible information about their benefits, leading to higher satisfaction and engagement
 Partners like HR and payroll platforms expand their offerings effortlessly with the company’s embeddable solutions
 
 What the Role Involves
 
 The company is seeking early Product Engineers who want to own problems end to end, from architecture to shipping to the partner conversation that shapes what gets built next. The Product Engineer will have autonomy and the room to make an outsized impact on the core product.
 
 In this role, the Product Engineer will be responsible for:
 Owning the transformation of the company’s core products to best-in-class experiences, from the benefit administration workflows and carrier integrations to embeddable user interfaces
 Driving product direction as a critical member of the early product engineering team
 Establishing robust technical foundations that scale with the company’s largest partners’ needs and future growth
 Cultivating partner relationships to identify and shape the roadmap and feature development
 
 Who the Ideal Candidate Is
 
 The ideal candidate could be a great fit if they:
 Possess exceptional engineering skills to build complex systems with elegant design and robust architecture
 Collaborate effectively with customers and partners to solve complex problems
 Exhibit strong product sense and translate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders effortlessly
 Learn quickly, motivate themselves, and execute rapidly while maintaining high quality standards
 Exhibit a profound curiosity for exploring overlooked nuances and niche areas within complex technical and industry domains
 
 Bonus: 
 Enjoy technical writing and sharing knowledge and their work with the broader team and wider community
 Bring 5+ years of experience designing and building systems through multiple lifecycles
 Have expertise in Django (Python) and/or React (TypeScript), which is not required but will help them ramp quickly
 Value code maintainability, testability, and clarity highly
 Communicate excellently, especially with non-technical team members and customers
 
 How the Team Works Today
 
 The company is a team of ~15 and growing, headquartered in NYC, with teammates between both coasts. It is small enough that everyone knows what everyone else is shipping, but big enough that nobody is alone on a problem. A few things that are true about working there:
 Ownership of the whole problem, not the ticket. Scoping, tradeoffs, and customer conversations all belong to the same person. Roadmaps are for direction, not instruction.
 Quality is not negotiable, speed usually is. The team ships fast when it is reversible and slowly when it is not. Knowing which is which is most of the job.
 The team writes things down. Decisions live in docs and public channels, not in DMs. It is how a team stays fast.
 
 Compensation Details
 The company offers competitive salaries in line with years of experience and work location. Its benefits include health insurance that is 100% covered, a $5K office budget, a stipend for home internet expenses, and unlimited PTO (with a 15-day minimum), among others.
 
 Base compensation for this position ranges from $180,000 – $220,000.
 
 Final offer amounts are determined by experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed.
